models_evaluated: AI software for chest radiography interpretation (unnamed)

links.outcome: Local concordance between AI outputs and radiologist reports at each site
links.effect: Guyana: 87% concordance for normal vs abnormal CXR triage; Nigeria: 85% concordance for tuberculosis reporting.
links.quote: In Guyana, it revealed an 87% concordance rate between radiologists and the AI model for triaging normal versus abnormal findings on CXR.

links.outcome: Change in knowledge test scores after introduction-to-AI course
links.effect: 30 participants; average pre-knowledge test score 75%, posttest score 95%.
links.quote: Thirty participants completed the introduction-to-AI course with an average pre-knowledge test score of 75% and an average posttest score of 95%.

unlisted_practices: Three-pronged implementation strategy for AI in LMICs (clinical education, PACS/cloud infrastructure installation, phased AI introduction)

screen.practice: local validation, clinician education, and phased AI introduction
screen.reason: Empirical case report evaluating the real-world deployment and implementation strategy (education, infrastructure, phased introduction with local validation) of chest radiograph AI across hospitals in Guyana and Nigeria.

primary.practice: phased implementation strategy with clinician AI education and local validation
